purpose: Defines entities that are placed on top of the generated base map and are not enemies spawned by the wave system.
rules: These entities are generated as a separate layer after the base map geometry and map assets exist.
They use SPAWN_LOCATION anchors in the same way as enemies, but are not selected by the enemy wave budget.
NPCs, containers, hazards and interactables may all have different placement and interaction rules while sharing one spawnable master structure.
Enemy wave spawning is handled separately and should be defined only after this map-spawned entity layer is specified.
